description:
What is This Part?
This is the Transmission Clutch Cable for the Suzuki Samurai that runs from the Shifter Arm located on the Transmission to the Clutch Pedal.
Comes With Pin, Nut & Spring Kit.
For LHD (Left Hand Drive) Samurai Models
Has Plastic Mounting Plate
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Clutch Cable 74″
Qty 1 – Pin
Qty 1 – Nut
Qty 1 – Spring
Qty 1 – Washer
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
